items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: His name was Herbert Tate. He played around Dallas with the bands, local, territory bands.

ctx.x: His name was Herbert Tate. He played around Dallas with the bands, local, territory bands. And every time he would leave, I'd get into it and break his reeds because I didn't know what I was doing and I told him when he brought me the alto, I says, "Well, really, this isn't what I really want." I says, "I really want to play a trombone." I used to get the curtains off the wall like that and I'd put them together and I'd slide them -- maybe I was about seven,
eight, then, you know. So then -- but he quickly told me, says, "This is it." He said, "The trombone is out." He says, "I had to scuffle to get this."
